copy.hero_sub: Joey Calloway has been fixing Marietta plumbing since 1993. Flat-rate quotes before the wrench turns. On-site in 45 minutes. License MP207455 on every truck.
copy.services_lead: Joey or his son Caleb does your job. Nobody else. Here's what we handle, and what it costs.

services.title: Main-Line Drain Clearing
services.body: Camera-jet diagnostics on every main-line call — we email you the recording before we leave.

services.title: Slab Leak Repair
services.body: Pinpointed and repaired flat. Sarah K. paid $1,890 for a slab repair another company quoted $4,500 just to find.

services.title: Water Heater Service
services.body: We tell you if yours has life left. We won't sell you a new one when a flush will do.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.body: Sundays and after-hours calls answered live. Joey came out at 11pm on a Saturday — that's the job.

services.title: Hydro-Jetting
services.body: High-pressure jetting clears grease, roots, and scale from 2-inch to 6-inch lines. Done in one visit.

what_we_dont_do: We don't send apprentices. Joey or Caleb — that's the whole crew.
We don't quote a low number and change it when we're done.
We don't push a replacement if your equipment has years left.
copy.guarantee: The price Joey quotes on the phone is the price on your invoice — or you pay nothing for the diagnostic.

reviews_list.author: Margaret W.
reviews_list.text: Joey himself came out Saturday at 11pm when my main line backed up. Quoted me before he started, no surprise charges. Camera-jetted the line and emailed me the recording. Done in 90 minutes.

reviews_list.author: David T.
reviews_list.text: Third plumber I called after two no-shows. Peach State picked up on the first ring, was at my house in 45 min, and the price he quoted on the phone is the price I paid. License # right on the truck.

reviews_list.author: Sarah K.
reviews_list.text: 32 years of doing this shows. Joey diagnosed a slab leak in 10 minutes that another company quoted me $4,500 to find. His repair: $1,890 flat.

reviews_list.author: Robert H.
reviews_list.text: Does not upsell. Told me my water heater had another 2-3 years if I flushed it; could have sold me a new one easy.

copy.footer_blurb: Joey Calloway has been under East Cobb sinks since 1993 — license MP207455, BBB A+, and Caleb's learning the trade right alongside him.

top_strengths: Owner-voice is exceptionally strong: named crew, real prices, 'what we don't do' callout, guarantee, and dated last-updated all present
Bebas/Inter pair gives the hero a trade-credible display weight that lifts it above pure template territory
Trust infrastructure is complete: license number, neighborhoods strip, sticky CTA, GMB star count — no gaps
top_weaknesses: Zero motion attributes — not even a subtle scroll-fade; page feels static and flat at a time when even mid-market competitors add entrance animations
No price signals on any service tile (distinct_service_price_signals: 0) — the copy mentions $1,890 in a review but the service cards themselves have no 'from $X' anchors
Bold-list services section almost certainly renders as rectangular cards with no layout break — no asymmetric grid, full-bleed image, or sticky-caption moment reported
must_fixes: Add 'from $X' or a price range to at least 3 service tiles (e.g., 'Main-Line Drain Clearing — from $189') so the specificity that lives in the reviews also lives in the offer cards
Introduce at least one scroll-triggered entrance animation (fade-up on service cards, or a counter ticking up to '187 reviews') — even 2 animated elements breaks the static ceiling

Break the rectangle somewhere: pull one service tile or the guarantee block full-bleed with an orange-graded photo background, or use an asymmetric two-column with a sticky caption to signal intentional layout craft
awwwards.one_line_verdict: Copy is punching agency; design is still playing it safe — add motion, break one layout rect, and put prices on the cards to close the gap.
